t: VAN HELSING (2004) - Castle Dracula Podcast Episode 1
s: The creators of the Alex Van Helsing book series (Jason Henderson), indy comic Halloween Man (Drew Edwards), and manga Psy-comm (Tony Salvaggio) dish on Van Helsing, the movie, while token female Julia provides wisdom and Jason prepares for release of Alex Van Helsing: Voice of the Undead. Spoilers!

t: FRIGHT NIGHT (1985) - Castle Dracula Podcast Episode 2
s: A look at the vampire/comedy/horror classic Fright Night while we anticipate the release of the Colin Farrell remake. Hosted by the creators of the Alex Van Helsing book series (Jason Henderson), indy comic Halloween Man (Drew Edwards), and manga Psy-comm (Tony Salvaggio), and token female attorney Julia Guzman. Spoilers!

t: LEGEND OF THE SEVEN GOLDEN VAMPIRES: Castle Dracula Podcast Episode 3
s: KUNG FU & VAMPIRES EPISODE. A look at the one the most awesome and awesomely off vampire movies ever, the kung-fu vampire extravaganza LEGEND OF THE SEVEN GOLDEN VAMPIRES starring Peter Cushing. Hosted by the creators of the Alex Van Helsing book series (Jason Henderson), indy comic Halloween Man (Drew Edwards), and manga Psy-comm (Tony Salvaggio), and token female attorney Julia Guzman. We'll cap it off with a look at kung fu, vampires, and of course Q&A from the audience!

t: INTERVIEW WITH THE VAMPIRE (1994): Castle Dracula Podcast Episode 4
s: A look at INTERVIEW WITH THE VAMPIRE, starring Brad Pitt and Tom Cruise. Hosted by the creators of the Alex Van Helsing book series (Jason Henderson) with panelists Julia Guzman, travel writer and attorney, Barb Lien-Cooper, creator of the online comic GUN STREET GIRL and adapter of many manga and manhwa titles published by Tokyopop and Viz Media, and Dr. Park Cooper, co-creator of the graphic novel HALF DEAD and editor-in-chief of comic-book publisher Septagon Studios. We'll cap it off with endorsements and of course Q&A from the audience!

t: THE LOST BOYS (1987) - Castle Dracula Podcast
s: CRY LITTLE SISTER! A look at one of the most important vampire movies of the last forty years, THE LOST BOYS, starring Kiefer Sutherland and Jason Patric. Hosted by the creators of the Alex Van Helsing book series (Jason Henderson), indy comic Halloween Man (Drew Edwards), and manga Psy-comm (Tony Salvaggio), and attorney Julia Guzman. s: We talk DRACULA AKA HORROR OF DRACULA, the Hammer vampire film starring Christopher Lee and Peter Cushing. t: RETURN OF THE LIVING DEAD - Castle Dracula Podcast (Horror & More)
s: A look at the funny, influential and oh so 80s zombie movie RETURN OF THE LIVING DEAD. Hosted by the creators of the Alex Van Helsing book series (Jason Henderson), indy comic Halloween Man (Drew Edwards), and manga Psy-comm (Tony Salvaggio). We'll cap it off with a look at zombies and pop culture, and of course Q&A from the audience!

t: THE HAUNTING (1963) - Castle Dracula Podcast (Horror & More)
s: This week the podcast discusses one of the greatest haunted house movies ever made, THE HAUNTING, directed by Robert Wise and starring Julie Harris. A movie of secrets "unnatural" love, this one will prickle your spine. This week's panel includes Jason "Alex Van Helsing" Henderson, Drew "Halloween Man" Edwards, and Julia "Token Female" Guzman!

t: NOSFERATU THE VAMPYRE- Castle Dracula Podcast (Horror & More)
s: The podcast looks at NOSFERATU THE VAMPYRE-- the amazing 1979 remake starring the truly weird Klaus Kinski and the apparently immortal, gorgeous Isabelle Adjanni.

t: TRICK 'R TREAT (2007 Anthology) Dracula Podcast (Horror & More)
s: A look at this 2007 horror movie in the fine tradition of horror anthologies going all the way back to Tales from the Crypt, but with a loopy Pulp Fiction-like timeline.

t: TRICK OR TREAT (1986) - Castle Dracula Podcast (Horror & More)
s: The podcast discusses the Halloween Movie that boasts Gene Simmons, Ozzy Osbourne, and "Skippy" from Family Ties!

t: IT'S THE GREAT PUMPKIN, CHARLIE BROWN- Castle Dracula Podcast
s: The podcast looks at the classic 1966 Halloween special, with a discussion of the meaning of the Great Pumpkin itself and what the World War I Flying Ace can tell us about the horrors or war and bobbing for apples.

t: DAUGHTERS OF DARKNESS (1971) - The Sexy Belgian Vampires Episode
s: We look at amazing, slightly salacious 1971 lesbian vampire movie Daughters of Darkness, about a pair of newlyweds drawn into the seductive web of a vampire countess whiling away her days at an off-season seaside resort. Replete with lesbian vampires, sudden death, and killer fashions. Join us!

t: GREMLINS-- The Bad Chimney Episode
s: A special Christmas treat from the Castle Dracula Podcast-- we discuss GREMLINS (1984) from director Joe Dante, the heartwarming story of a boy and his multiplying, lizardlike, homicidal pets.

t: RARE EXPORTS: A CHRISTMAS TALE
s: We discuss the wild and scary 2010 horror movie RARE EXPORTS, about a Finnish boy who discovers that Santa is an evil creature recently excavated by scientists and whose reign of terror must be stopped.

t: THE TERMINATOR (1984)
s: In honor of the 2012 Comsumer Electronic Show, we discuss THE TERMINATOR, James Cameron's sensitive portrayal of a woman trying to escape a murderous cyborg from the future. (Arnold Schwarzenegger, Linda Hamilton.)

t: BRAM STOKER'S DRACULA (1992) - The Itty Bitty Glasses Episode
s: We discuss BRAM STOKER'S DRACULA, the 1992 Hollywood vampire movie that launched a neo-Gothic cycle and gave us a long-haired Dracula in John Lennon glasses. Also a Dracula with an old lady bun, so two for the price of one, there.

t: THE BIRDS (Hitchcock Film Series)
s: We kick off our review of Alfred Hitchcock's masterful suspense films with The Birds (1963), starring Tippi Hedren.

t: Media Life Interview: Ernie Cline, Writer of Ready Player One and Fanboys
s: Jason chats with New York Times Best Selling author Ernie Cline, whose Ready Player One is an addictive, futuristic love letter to the 1980s.

t: PSYCHO (Hitchcock Film Series)
s: We look at the legendary Psycho (1960) starring Anthony Perkins, Janet Leigh, and the music of Bernard Herrmann.

t: VERTIGO (Hitchcock Film Series)
s: We discuss Alfred Hitchcock's VERTIGO (1958), about a private detective who falls for a woman who may be possessed by a ghost. Starring James Stewart, Kim Novak and Barbara Bel Geddes.

t: THE BATMAN VS. DRACULA (2005)
s: In honor of the return of the the caped crusader in THE DARK KNIGHT RISES, we take a look at the 2005 animated feature THE BATMAN VERSUS DRACULA.

t: ROSEMARY'S BABY: The Evil Babies Retrospective
s: He has his father's eyes! We kick off our EVIL BABIES RETROSPECTIVE with a look at Roman Polanski's ultra-modern look at the antichrist. Starring Mia Farrow.

t: THE OMEN (1976): The Evil Baby Retrospective
s: We look at a contender for the scariest devil baby movie of them all, the creeptastic Omen-- the original, starring Gregory Peck.

t: DAMIEN: OMEN II (Evil Baby Retrospective)
s: The podcast returns to the world of everyone's favorite demonic preppie, Damien. Join us!

t: OMEN III: THE FINAL CONFLICT
s: We wrap up our Evil Baby Retrospective with the final chapter in the Omen series, where we find Damien grown up and ascending to power! Starring Sam Neill. (1981)

t: BLOOD & ROSES (1960)- The Sexy Vampires Retrospective
s: Kicking off our Sexy Vampires Retrospective, we talk Roger Vadim's lush, mod eurohorror Blood & Roses, based on Sheridan Le Fanu's Carmilla.

t: THE HUNGER (1983): The Sexy Vampire Retrospective
s: We continue our look at the best-- or at least most, ahem, compelling-- of film's sexiest vampire movies. This time it's The Hunger from the late, great Tony Scott. Starring Catherine Denueve, Susan Sarandon and David Bowie.

t: VAMPIRE LOVERS- The Sexy Vampire Retrospective
s: We look at the first of the Hammer Karnstein Trilogy, 1970 lesbian vampire movie VAMPIRE LOVERS, starring the lovely Ingrid Pitt.

t: LUST FOR A VAMPIRE (1971): Sexy Vampire Retrospective
s: The Sexy vampire Retrospective returns with the second film in the Karnstein/ Carmilla cycle from Hammer, TO LOVE A VAMPIRE, AKA LUST FOR A VAMPIRE, AKA LOVE FOR A VAMPIRE. You choose the title, we deliver the gossamer, slightly NSFW vampires of this early 70s' gothic gem.

t: TWINS OF EVIL (1971): The Sexy Vampire Retrospective
s: We wrap up the Karnstein Trilogy from hammer studios with a vampire movie about a pair of twins, one good, one evil, starring Peter Cushing and the sensational Collinson Twins.

t: CABIN IN THE WOODS: October is here!
s: The podcast kicks off a groovy, dark October with the amazing 2012 CABIN IN THE WOODS, written by Joss Whedon.

t: SALEM'S LOT (1979): The Stephen King Retrospective
s: We kick off the Stephen King Retrospective with Salem's Lot, the 1979 miniseries starring David Soul, which still freaks us way out.

t: THE SHINING (1981): The Stephen King Retrospective
s: The Castle Dracula Podcast takes on one of the scariest movies of all time, starring Jack Nicholson, Shelley Duvall, Scatman Crothers and Colorado.

t: SILVER BULLET (1985): The Stephen King Retrospective
s: We celebrate Halloween with 1985 SILVER BULLET, based on Stephen King's novella Cycle of the Werewolf. Starring Corey Haim as a wheelchair-bound kid ready to take on a hidden enemy, and Gary Busey as the uncle who has his back.

t: CREEPSHOW: The Stephen King Retrospective
s: We take on CREEPSHOW, the anthology movie that made us all fear cockroaches, antique crates, and Leslie Nielsen. With special guest Adam Foshko, writer of Activision's SKYLANDERS.

t: ABRAHAM LINCOLN, VAMPIRE HUNTER: The Election 2012 Post-Mortem Episode
s: We discuss the 2012 vampire-hunting film that dares to ask something that never occurred to us: was that axe of Honest Abe's actually there so he could KILL VAMPIRES?

t: NIGHTMARE BEFORE CHRISTMAS
s: We take a look at Tim Burton's classic animated Christmas/Halloween tale of Jack Skellington, King of Halloween, and his rivalry with Santa Claus.

t: SCROOGED: The Scary Christmas Episode
s: We look at a Christmas gem that tends to be forgotten-- Bill Murray starring in a smart, funny update of A Christmas Carol (at least that's what one of us thinks, and you know how we disagree.)

t: HOUSE OF THE DEVIL
s: The Podcast takes on the 2009 horror/pastiche House of the Devil, shot on 16mm and made to hearken to horror of the early 80s.

t: LITTLE SHOP OF HORRORS: Musical Horror Retrospective
s: We kick off our Musical Horror Retrospective with the 1986 film version of the off-broadway sensation LITTLE SHOP OF HORRORS, starring Rick Moranis and Ellen Greene.

t: ROCKY HORROR PICTURE SHOW: The Musical Horror Retrospective
s: There's a light over at the Frankenstein place-- the wild, wild world of Dr. Frank N. Furter, Eddie, Columbia, Magenta, Brad and Janet.

t: PHANTOM OF THE PARADISE: The Musical Horror Retrospective
s: We continue our wild, wild look at musical horror movies with Brian DePalma's rock opera PHANTOM OF THE PARADISE.

t: SWEENEY TODD: The Musical Horror Retrospective
s: The gang looks at Sweeney Todd, Tim Burton's grand guignol adaptation of the Sondheim musical, starring Johnny Depp as the Demon Barber of Fleet Street.

t: DRACULA 1979 STARRING FRANK LANGELLA: Special 50th Episode!
s: For our FIFTIETH EPISODE we go back to one of the best Draculas ever, the suave, dangerous Frank Langella in John Badham's 1979 DRACULA.
